name: Lateral Raise
common_faults: shrugging into upper traps at the top
internal rotation (thumbs down) increasing impingement risk

substitutions.note: compound shoulder press; less isolated lateral delt
compound; more front delt and tricep

contraindications: shoulder impingement aggravated by abduction arc
resistance_profile: hardest at the top of the arc (90° abduction); minimal resistance at the sides

provenance.notes: Cable variant provides constant tension through arc unlike dumbbell version. Lighter loads than compound presses due to isolation of lateral deltoid. SFR heuristic.
